test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_first_last_32 ( x Array(UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_first_last_128 ( x Array(UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_first_last_complex ( tuple_values Array(Tuple(UInt64, UInt64)), nested_values Array(Array(UInt64)) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_first_last_32 SELECT arrayResize([toUInt64(number)], 32) FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO array_first_last_128 SELECT arrayResize([toUInt64(number)], 128) FROM numbers(500000)
INSERT INTO array_first_last_complex SELECT arrayMap(x -> (x, x), range(32)), arrayMap(x -> [x, x], range(32)) FROM numbers(250000)
